name: Suvorexant
description: A dual orexin receptor antagonist approved for insomnia, acting by blocking the wake-promoting orexin system rather than by potentiating GABA.

systems.note: Orexin receptor blockade removing wake drive; the labelled mechanism.
CYP3A4-metabolised; not recommended in severe hepatic impairment.

monitors.why: Labelled next-day somnolence, sleep paralysis and worsening depression.
